means: For every scored T-spin in the corpus (a T with an engine spin credit that cleared lines, inside the verified prefix, passing the reconstruction check), whether harddrop's Hamburger local shape stood around it: the lock's cells are the page's T laid flat, nub down, at a full TSS (as drawn, or mirrored), and every cell of the window around it — the roof over the T's far end, the open cells over the well, the row the TSS clears (the cover over the well) and the hole under the cover — is filled or empty as drawn. Every hit is followed to the first later piece that enters the well's column, to see whether it is the Tetris the page ends on; a piece that fills the well without one is the page's next layer.
not_eligible_because: simulator output: which local shape a T went into is read off the vendored Triangle engine's boards, and nothing on the corpus side has a second implementation of it. No claim id, no badge, no figure in a report.
caveat: garbage is read as FILLED inside the window, and its hole columns are the engine's seeded-RNG columns, never observed directly (oracle-source.ts): the hole under the cover can be a garbage row's hole, which counts, so a hit's well is the board the oracle offered, and a hit with garbage in its window is named in garbage_in_window for that reason. At a full TSS the cleared row is entailed by the clear (NaiveClauseForced), and so is the well re-opening inside the window: the payoff (an I clearing 4 into the well, inside the verified prefix) is what the window does not decide. A payoff reason of well_covered or well_filled_not_i is the page's repetition (another layer stacked over the well), not a failure. Counts only, always N / M with the denominator.
rules: opportunity: a T lock with spin "full" clearing 1 line, at a 0-based lock index <= the verified index, whose board-before plus its cells makes exactly the rows the engine recorded clearing (the reconstruction check, counted exactly as opener-facts.json donation.check counts it)

match: the lock's cells equal the variant's flat T under one translation (mirrored: columns reflected in the window), and every other window cell is filled (a piece or garbage) or empty as the page draws it; colour is never compared; cells outside the window are not read
mirrored is tried only when as-drawn fails; a window leaving the board is no match (window_off_board)

payoff: the well cell under the cover, two columns from the nub away from the roof, carried through every clear and garbage insertion, each step verified against the engine's next board, to the first later lock with a cell in its column; fired iff that lock is inside the verified prefix, has a cell at or below the carried cell, is an I and cleared 4 lines (otherwise past_verified, well_covered, well_filled_not_i, i_in_well_not_quad, rowmap_unverified, slot_off_board or round_ended); well_depth = the empty cells under the well cell on the board before the spin, garbage filled
controls: the same window at scored full TSD and TST and mini TSS and TSD; ablations no_must_empty, no_roof and t_overlap at the opportunity; orientation_baseline = opportunities whose T stands up
window_rule: 0-based lock index <= 21 is in_opener (emit-opener-facts.ts's convention; emit-attack-facts.ts counts from 1)

rules: fragment: a key cell — the cover over the hole (the cleared row's cells at the well and next to the nub: one S or Z, or other complete pieces, one or several, yachi's 「用S/Z 砌hamburger 先算，除非有其他完整piece 砌到」) or the roof over the T's far end — belongs to a piece not all four of whose cells are on the board before the T (a line clear cut it)
garbage_in_shape: a key cell is garbage (the hole under the cover may be a garbage row's hole; the cover may not be garbage)
shape_cell_empty: a key cell is empty (the window requires it filled, so only a weakened window can admit this)
in_opener: the T locks inside the opener window (0-based lock <= WINDOW_PIECES); this is a mid-game page, so an opener hit (SDPC Spin or stick spin bag 1) never counts (yachi: 「開局唔洗計啦，叫得中盤」)
dpc: the board is empty after one of the 14 locks before the T, the T itself, or one of the 14 after it (the DPC setup)
ownership_unverified: a lock before the T has a row map the digest could not verify, so its pieces cannot be told apart

not_whole_shape: none of the source page's own drawings of the variant (its board and its agreement drawings) stands around the T cell for cell by occupancy, in either hand — each drawing read as the T, every enclosed hole touching it or within three rows under it, and a one-cell margin (technique-wholeshape.ts)
qualifies iff none applies; the shape stood at every hit either way

cover (a field, not a rule): one_sz when one whole S or Z covers both cover cells, complete_pieces when whole pieces do otherwise, not_complete when a cover cell is garbage or a fragment, null when ownership is unverified
